description: Certificate & deposit state-transition edges (cardano 11.1.2 vs amaru 0925), extending the stake/pool-withdrawal family. Reachable intra-tx cert-sequence edges with fresh creds: dereg-unregistered, reg+dereg round-trip, dereg wrong-refund (deposit exactness), vote-deleg to a nonexistent DRep. amaru accepting a bad state transition or mis-accounting a deposit where cardano rejects = HIGH. Verdict -> reason-class -> credential parity, fail-closed. NOT expressible on the frozen substrate (documented): intra-tx double-registration (Conway certs are a SET -> identical certs dedup); delegate-to-retired-pool, pool-reReg-after-retirement, DRep-already-registered, expired-DRep (need pre-existing on-chain state / a gov re-bake).

cases.note: deregister a fresh, never-registered stake cred -> both reject (not registered), same cred
reg (deposit 2 ADA) + dereg declaring 1 ADA refund in one tx -> both reject IncorrectDeposit (deposit exactness on the refund)
register + vote-delegate to a nonexistent DRep key-hash -> both reject (DRep not registered), same DRep id
register then deregister the same fresh cred in one tx (deposit charged then refunded) -> both accept
